name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement

---

## Problem / Motivation
What problem does this feature solve? What job does it do?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature you'd like. Be specific about UX, API, or data model changes.

## Alternatives Considered
What alternatives did you consider? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Area / Module Affected
Which area, module, or system component is affected? (e.g. FCP area, RAG pipeline, export system)
